questions.question: The average age of 24 students in a class is 15.5 years. The age of their teacher is 28 years more than the average of all twenty-five. What is the age of the teacher in years?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

The average age of 24 students in a class is 15.5 years. The age of their teacher is 28 years more than the average of all twenty-five.

**Formula Used**:

average = sum of observation/number of observation

**Calculation**:

Average age of 24 students in the class = 15.5 years

⇒ Total age of 24 students = 24 × 15.5 = 372 years

Let age of teacher = x years and average age of all 25 = (372 + x)/(25)

⇒ x = 28 + (372 + x)/(25)

⇒ 25x - x = 700 + 372

⇒ x = (1072)/(24) = (134)/(3)

Thus, age of teacher = 44(2)/(3) years

questions.question: If 12, x, 8 and 14 are in proportion, then what is the mean proportional between (x - 12) and (x + 4)?
questions.solution:
Formula:

Mean proportion of x and y = √xy

**Calculation**:

12, x, 8 and 14 are in proportion,

⇒ (12/x) = (8/14)

⇒ 8x = 14 × 12

⇒ x = 7 × 3 = 21

The mean proportional between (x - 12) and (x + 4) = √(21 - 12) × (21 + 4)

⇒ √9 × 25

⇒ 15

**∴ The mean proportional is 15. **

questions.question: A shopkeepers made a profit of 16% on his goods. If the price at which he buys decreases by 20% while he reduces his selling price by 23%, what is now his percentage of profit? (correct to one decimal place)
questions.solution:
**Given**:

A shopkeepers made a profit of 16% on his goods.

**Formula Used**:

profit = selling price - cost price 

**Calculation**:

Let his cost price = Rs. 100x

⇒ Selling price to get 16% profit = (116)/(100) × 100x = Rs. 116x

⇒ Now, new cost price = (80)/(100) × 100x = Rs. 80x

⇒ New selling price = (77)/(100) × 116x = Rs. 89.32x 

∴ New Profit % = (89.32x - 80x)/(80x) × 100

⇒ (9.32)/(4) times 5 = 11.6%

∴ required profit = 11.6 %

questions.question: At what percentage above the cost price must an article be marked so as to gain 38% after allowing a customer a discount of 8% on the marked price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discount = 8%

Profit percentage = 38%

**Concept used:**

Discount is calculated on MP whereas profit is calculated on CP.

**Calculation**: 

Let cost price = Rs. 100x

⇒ Profit % = 38%

⇒ Selling price = (138)/(100) times 100x = Rs. 138x

After discount of 8%, marked price = (138x)/(92) times 100 = Rs. 150x

∴ Markup % = ((150x - 100x))/(100x) = 50%

questions.question: The numbers 6, 8, 11, 12, 2x - 8, 2x + 10, 35, 41, 42, 50 are written in ascending order. If their median is 25, then what is the mean of the numbers?
questions.solution:
**Calculation**:

⇒ Numbers in ascending order : 6, 8, 11, 12, 2x - 8, 2x + 10, 35, 41, 42, 50

The number of terms is 10 i.e. even number.

Thus, 

Median of 10 numbers is the mean of 5th and 6th numbers.

Rightarrow ((2x - 8) + (2x + 10))/(2) = 25

Rightarrow 4x + 2 = 50

Rightarrow x = (48)/(4) = 12

Thus, sum of the numbers are = 6 + 8 + 11 + 12 + 16 + 34 + 35 + 41 + 42 + 50 = 255

∴ Mean = (255)/(10) = 25.5

questions.question: A can complete (2)/(3) of a work in 8 days. B can complete (3)/(5) of the same work in 12 days and C can complete (4)/(9) of the same work in 8 days. If A and B worked together for 5 days., then find how much time (in days) will C alone take to complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

A can complete (2)/(3) of a work in 8 days. B can complete (3)/(5) of the same work in 12 days and C can complete (4)/(9) of the same work in 8 days. A and B worked together for 5 days.

**Calculation**:

Let total work to be done be L.C.M.(3, 5, 9) = 45 units

Thus, A complete (2)/(3)of the work in 8 days, => 30 units in 8 days

⇒ A's efficiency = (30)/(8) = 3.75 units/day 

Similarly, B's efficiency = (27)/(12) = 2.25 units/day

and C's efficiency = (20)/(8) = 2.5 units/day

Now, work done by A and B in 5 days = (3.75 + 2.25) × 5 = 30 units

∴ Remaining work done by C in = ((45-30))/(2.5) = 6 days

questions.question: Let x be the least multiple of 29 which when divided by 20, 21, 22, 24 and 28 then the remainders are 13, 14, 15, 17 and 21 respectively. What is the sum of digits of x?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

x be the least multiple of 29 which when divided by 20, 21, 22, 24 and 28 then the remainders are 13, 14, 15, 17 and 21 respectively. 

**Calculation**:

⇒ Since, the difference between the all the numbers are : (20 - 13), (21 - 14) = 7

Thus, L.C.M. (20, 21, 22, 24, 28) = 9240

Hence, required number will be in the form of = 9240k - 7 = multiple of 29

By hit and trial, we see that k = 2 satisfy above equation, thus required number = 9240 × 2 - 7 = 18473

⇒ Sum of digits = 1 + 8 + 4 + 7 + 3 = 23

questions.question: A takes 6 hours more than B to cover a distance of 60 km. But if A doubles his speed, he takes 3 hours less than B to cover the same distance. The speed (in km/hr) of A is:
questions.solution:
**Given**:

A takes 6 hours more than B to cover a distance of 60 km. But if A doubles his speed, he takes 3 hours less than B to cover the same distance. 

**Formula Used**:

Time = distance/Speed

**Calculation**:

Let speed of A = x km/hr and speed of B = y km/hr

A takes 6 hours more than B to cover a distance of 60 km.

⇒ 60/x – 60/y = 6

⇒ 1/x – 1/y = 6/60

⇒ 1/x – 1/y = 1/10 ----(1)

A doubles his speed, he takes 3 hours less than B to cover the same distance.

⇒ 60/2x – 60/y = - 3

⇒ 1/2x – 1/y = - 3/60

⇒ 1/2x – 1/y = - 1/20 ----(2)

Subtracting equation 2 from equation 1

⇒ 1/x – 1/2x = 1/10 – (- 1/20)

⇒ 1/2x = 3/20

⇒ x = 10/3

∴ Speed of A = 3(1)/(3) km/hr

questions.question: Two vessels A and B contain solution of acid and water. In A and B the ratio of acid and water are 7 : 3 and 4 : 1, respectively. They are mixed in the ratio 1 : 2. What is the ratio of acid and water in the resulting solution?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

Two vessels A and B contain solution of acid and water. In A and B the ratio of acid and water are 7 ∶ 3 and 4 ∶ 1, respectively. They are mixed in the ratio 1 ∶ 2. 

**Calculation**:

In 1 unit of vessel A, quantity of acid = (7)/(10) × 1 = (7)/(10)

Quantity of water = (3)/(10) × 1 = (3)/(10)

Similarly, in 2 units of vessel B, quantity of acid = (4)/(5) × 2 = (8)/(5)

Quantity of water = (1)/(5) × 2 = (2)/(5)

The ratio of acid and water in the resulting solution = [((7)/(10) + (8)/(5)) : ((3)/(10) + (2)/(5))]

= (23)/(10) : (7)/(10)

⇒ 23 ∶ 7

**∴ The ratio of acid and water in the resulting solution is 23 ∶ 7.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** Acid : Water

A ⇒ 7 : 3 [Total Quantity = (7 + 3) = 10]

B ⇒ 4 : 1 [Total Quantity = (4 + 1) = 5]

Now, 

Quantity of A = 10 units and B = 5 units

They were mix in the ratio of 1 : 2, that means

If A = 10 units, then B will have to be 20 units

Multiplying Elements of B by 4, we get

 Acid : Water

A ⇒ 7 : 3 [Total Quantity = (7 + 3) = 10]

B ⇒ 4 × 4 : 1 × 4 [Total Quantity = (16 + 4) = 20]

 (7 + 16) : (3 + 4) = 23 : 7

questions.question: A 280 m long train is running at 108 km/hr. In how much time will it cross a bridge of length 170 m?
questions.solution:
**Given**:

A 280 m long train is running at 108 km/hr.

**Formula Used**:

speed = distance/time

**Calculation**:

⇒ Speed of train = 108 × (5)/(18) m/s = 30 m/s

Distance covered = 280 + 170 = 450

∴ Time taken = (450)/(30) = 15 seconds
